description: Diagnostic requests for the three fixture cases. Each request is assembled against the field manifest of the named run; the assembler never sees the series values.

requests.request: chart zone1 air temperature and zone2 air temperature and add a diff table of zone1 air temperature with the peak value and a kpi card for total heating energy
requests.note: The ground truth for this case depends on zone1_air_temperature leaving its reference band and on zone2_air_temperature staying inside it; the diff table must carry the band declared by the run.

requests.request: plot the floor boundary temperature and compare it with the ground baseline temperature in a diff table
requests.note: The ground truth depends on floor_boundary_temperature and on the constant 9.4 degC baseline series; the diff table binds both.

requests.request: chart the zone1 relative humidity and zone1 latent load and add a diff table of zone1 relative humidity
requests.note: The ground truth depends on the humidity and latent-load series, not on temperature.
The field is declared by the run but carries no values: the spec is valid and the renderer must show 'no data' rather than invent a series.
Exercises ZoneHighlight: the zone id is derived from the field name.

requests.request: show the last 20 lines of the run log
show the run inputs and provenance
